problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a C² convex function f on ℝᵈ with an attained minimum x⋆, ‖x₀−x⋆‖≤R, and f(x₀)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Oracle 0 returns g(x,ξ), with independent identically distributed seeds, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), and E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤σ². Each sample counts as one call.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Oracle 1 returns a deterministic measurable linear operator H(x) satisfying ‖H(x)−∇²f(x)‖op≤δ uniformly in x. Symmetry is not explicitly required. Full operator evaluations are counted separately from gradient samples; no function-value oracle is supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y with ‖y−x‖≤ρ, ‖∇²f(y)−∇²f(x)‖op≤(M₀+M₁‖∇f(x)‖)‖y−x‖, where M₀,M₁≥0 and ρ>0. No global constant bound on the Hessian or its Lipschitz modulus is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform additive gradient variance bound σ² with σ≥0; no bounded-noise or exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: Hessian errors may be arbitrary deterministic errors bounded by δ≥0 in operator norm. No Hessian unbiasedness assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), with Euclidean vector norms and induced operator norms.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All Params are public, including d,x₀,M₀,M₁,ρ,δ,σ,R,Δ,ε,β and the seed type. The objective and minimizer are hidden. R,Δ,ε>0 and 0<β<1. Oracle budgets are fixed separate call caps.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output x̂ satisfying f(x̂)−f(x⋆)≤ε on the success event; no last-iterate requirement is imposed.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(x̂)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤β, over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness, with 0<β<1.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines local gradient-dependent Hessian regularity, finite-variance stochastic gradients, uniformly inexact deterministic Hessians, and high-probability objective accuracy under separate fixed oracle budgets.
